Until the build moves those 10 files, a frozen install on the branch fails. E2 is the type check and runs after the build. pnpm format, pnpm lint and the list ratchet passed. The plan copy was refreshed to the re-signed plan (body 9733d6f02e73); its slice 1 section, Files table and E1 and E2 rows are unchanged.
